test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Richard Dawkins __written the foreword__ to the second edition of the book.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**wrote the foreword**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is written in the past tense.
 
• The correct verb form for past tense with third person singular subject (Richard Dawkins) is '**wrote**'.
 
• '**Written**' is the past participle form of the verb &
